author: North
name: VoiceTranscribe
description: Uses local faster-whisper speech recognition to reply to native Discord voice messages with text. No paid API.
install_msg: Install faster-whisper in the Redbot virtualenv; model downloads on first voice message. Use [p]vt on/off/ignore.
end_user_data_statement: No end-user audio or transcripts are retained by this cog. Audio is processed in a temporary directory and deleted after transcription; transcriptions are posted to Discord.
